data.body: S2d PS4 (fa578daa3b) pushed to Gerrit 1976. Addressed PS3 LLM advisory findings: (1) BEHAVIORAL regression fix — audit is a help-backed nested intercept ({show,serve}) but _NESTED_FAMILY was derived only from bridge's factory, so 'audit serve --help' was intercepted to the pinned top-level audit.txt instead of falling through to the child's own usage. Added _NESTED_INTERCEPTS={audit} to _NESTED_FAMILY; RED-first behavioral test (iterates ALL help-backed nested families, drift-proof) in test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py. Verified: audit --help -> pinned top-level; audit serve/show --help -> child usage. (2) removed redundant test_generator_script_exists change-detector; (3) added missing-artifact + stray-artifact(_write prunes) branch coverage to the sandboxed gen oracle. All green: b8de 25/25, gen 8/8, held-out 13/13, affected contracts 53/53, generators --check clean, lint+typecheck+complexity clean. Gerrit removed outdated votes; both bots re-running.
